claims.proof_status: Self-contained conditional prose proof. Internal review only; no independent review or proof-assistant verification.
claims.priority_status: Finite application of established or elementary mathematical foundations. No claim that the underlying theorem family is newly discovered.
claims.assumptions: Two finite joint laws with total-variation error at most delta and an event positive under both.
claims.conclusion: Conditional total variation is at most min(1,delta/max(P(E),Q(E))); the bound is sharp for general joint laws.
claims.limits: Rare events can amplify approximation. An event impossible in one model requires separate treatment.
companion_groups: conditional stability and rare-evidence counterexample
